content.title: Close the security modal with the close button
content.intent: Prove the open security modal closes when the close button is used.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: state_flow for the modal-open to modal-closed transition; equivalence partitioning over supported dismissal methods, with the close button kept separate because the PRD names it as an independent close route. strength=2 by risk judgement because no money, auth, or data-loss factors apply; no covering-array sweep was needed because the path varies by one dismissal method.
